placement.interpretation: The four TP shards of the 51B FP8 PLE n-gram embedding plus input embedding remain resident in pinned host RAM and GPU-addressable through UVA after checkpoint load. The external NTFS model tree is a cold-load source, not a decode-time weight stream.

serving.draft_execution_caveat: The QWEN4_EXP_EXP_QSA_STATE backend does not provide fused multi-step draft decode. vLLM rebuilt attention metadata between MTP draft steps; this is a supported fallback and may limit throughput.

shutdown.caveat: All requests completed before the operator stopped the idle server. All four workers logged completed shutdown, the API completed application shutdown, and nothing remained. After those worker-completion messages, the executor still reported three worker handles and sent SIGTERM; the process manager force-killed the lingering EngineCore process. The asynchronous output task then reported the stopped-engine exception, and Python reported one shared-memory object for cleanup.

host_health.unrelated_corrected_events: The captured window contains five complete corrected Samsung NVMe endpoint reports at 0000:01:00.0 plus one additional three-line Samsung NVMe RxErr report. Every fully reported PCIe event had zero uncorrected status and no entry named a B70 address.

quality.helper_exit_code_interpretation: Expected and captured because the inherited target baseline itself passes five of seven strict cases; the exact baseline-comparison and incremental gates are authoritative.
quality.interpretation: With enable_thinking=false held constant, MTP4 exactly matched all 26 normalized MTP0 outputs and hashes in the bounded battery. The inherited target quality remains five of seven, so this is parity evidence rather than full model-quality qualification.

speculative_decode.endpoint_scope: Cumulative metrics endpoint captured after the completed quality session, three preceding timing invocations whose shared filename retained only the final row, and three corrected measured speed rows.
speculative_decode.counter_caveat: These cumulative counters establish MTP4 engagement and cache-zero session behavior, but they are not attributed to an individual request. They include all three preceding timing invocations even though their shared filename retained only the final raw row.

speed.workload: p146/o256/c1, three sequential measured requests after one per-invocation untimed warmup, full-output rate after first text
speed.variation_caveat: The three rows span 12.27% of the median. Comparisons to MTP0/MTP1/MTP2/MTP3 are descriptive cross-run evidence, not same-window causal A/Bs.
speed.accounting_caveat: This is the same narrow after-first-text repetitive-prompt screen as the configured-512 MTP controls, not the conventional realistic-suite 99-interval final gate.

qualification.next_gate: Publish only the TP4/eager/MTP4/active-context-0 Grade-C cell. MTP4 exact-4K remains unqualified; the configured-512 TP4 MTP0-4 depth grid is otherwise complete.

operator_correction.event: The first three timing invocations used a literal shell-variable filename and overwrote one another, leaving only the third result.
operator_correction.resolution: Both surviving files were retained and checksummed, then the identical three-row workload was rerun with distinct filenames. No service identity or model setting changed.
